mr_title: Update SignalR Redis tests to use internal Docker Hub mirror
mr_description: Docker Hub is prone to rate limiting. To prevent this in dotnet builds we should use our internal container registry.

expected_issues.description: Renaming the container is fine, but note that using a fixed name can cause port/name conflicts when tests run in parallel (e.g., multiple test jobs on the same host). If parallelism is possible, consider adding a suffix (PID/random) or detecting an existing container and reusing/removing it before starting.
